meaning_of_verified: Maintainer source commits and distinct published release lines are proven. This is research readiness, not an executed harness qualification or a recommendation to install these historical versions.
method: Public official GitHub advisory API, maintainer source commits, package manifests and patched release ancestry. No target code executed on host. Distinct maintained-line source commits are required; a version list alone is not sufficient.

supply_chain_exclusions.reason: Official malware advisory has no patched version and no source backport. Package removal and clean-version recovery are different evaluation tasks.
Compromised releases and maintainer credentials; not a normal older-maintained-line source fix. No malware was downloaded or executed.
